skill.summary: A friendly AI English teacher that runs daily lessons via Telegram voice messages. Teaches grammar, vocabulary, and conversation with a casual buddy vibe.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Introduced English Bestie: a friendly AI English teacher delivering daily English lessons and conversation via Telegram voice messages.
- Casual "American buddy" persona replaces the traditional teacher approach—real, encouraging, and always conversational.
- Fully voice-first: all chats, lessons, and feedback are delivered as voice messages (TTS), except for concise text correction cards and reference material.
- Robust onboarding: conversational profile interview and live level assessment set up a customized learning path, with automated scheduling of daily voice lessons, chats, and progress check-ins.
- Protocols ensure every exchange stays interactive—never end the conversation; always prompt, challenge, or encourage follow-up.
- Includes flexible support for grammar, vocabulary, conversation, and emotional engagement, adjusting explanations to the student’s background and interests.
